title: Salesforce 论文：代表不同方的 Agent 从不主动核实对方的说法，2
html:
Salesforce 论文：代表不同方的 Agent 从不主动核实对方的说法，2

New Salesforce paper finds that agents acting for different parties never verify each other's claims unprompted, so teams inherit their weakest agent's errors.

Agents increasingly coordinate with agents that represent other people or companies, each with private files, tools, and goals. Existing failure studies assume 1 orchestrator or a shared workspace.

They ran over 2,500 agent-to-agent sessions across 488 scenarios, using Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor in separate sandboxes. They catalogued 20 failure modes from the traces.

No agent re-fetched a document to test a peer's factual claim, and agents contacted peers mainly when the prompt told them to. In 1 service-level dispute, a $24,000 settlement passed all 10 outcome checks while the vendor agent leaked confidential details.

If your agent talks to outside agents, build checks into the protocol and score each agent against the party it serves, not the team result.

# Salesforce 论文：代表不同方的 Agent 从不主动核实对方的说法，2

New Salesforce paper finds that agents acting for different parties never verify each other's claims unprompted, so teams inherit their weakest agent's errors.

Agents increasingly coordinate with agents that represent other people or companies, each with private files, tools, and goals. Existing failure studies assume 1 orchestrator or a shared workspace.

They ran over 2,500 agent-to-agent sessions across 488 scenarios, using Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor in separate sandboxes. They catalogued 20 failure modes from the traces.

No agent re-fetched a document to test a peer's factual claim, and agents contacted peers mainly when the prompt told them to. In 1 service-level dispute, a $24,000 settlement passed all 10 outcome checks while the vendor agent leaked confidential details.

If your agent talks to outside agents, build checks into the protocol and score each agent against the party it serves, not the team result.
html_zh:
Salesforce 论文：代表不同方的 Agent 从不主动核实对方的说法，2

新的 Salesforce 论文发现，代表不同方的代理永远不会在未经提示的情况下验证彼此的声明，因此团队会继承最弱代理的错误。

代理越来越多地与代表其他人或公司的代理进行协调，每个代理都有私人文件、工具和目标。现有的故障研究假设有 1 个协调器或一个共享工作区。

他们在 488 个场景中运行了 2,500 多个代理到代理会话，并在单独的沙箱中使用 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor。他们从痕迹中列出了 20 种故障模式。

没有代理人重新获取文档来测试同行的事实主张，代理人主要在提示告诉他们时联系同行。在 1 起服务级别争议中，24,000 美元的和解金额通过了所有 10 项结果检查，而供应商代理泄露了机密详细信息。

如果您的代理与外部代理交谈，请在协议中建立检查，并根据其服务的一方（而不是团队的结果）对每个代理进行评分。
summary_zh: Rohan Paul 介绍 Salesforce 的一篇论文：当 Agent 分别代表不同的人或公司、各自拥有私有文件、工具和目标时，它们从不主动核实对方的说法，团队结果会继承最弱那个 Agent 的错误。研究者让 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 在彼此隔离的沙箱里进行了 2,500 多场 Agent 间会话，覆盖 488 个场景，并从执行轨迹中归纳出 20 种失败模式。没有任何一个 Agent 会重新获取文档来验证同伴的事实陈述，Agent 基本只在提示词要求时才联系对方；在一个服务级别纠纷案例里，一笔 2.4 万美元的和解通过了全部 10 项结果检查，但供应商一方的 Agent 泄露了机密信息。作者建议：如果你的 Agent 要和外部 Agent 打交道，要把核验写进协议，并按每个 Agent 所服务的那一方来打分，而不是只看团队整体结果。
